items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I played with Teddy Wilson and Milt Hinton, just like that.

ctx.x: Yeah, Joe Venuti. And Milt Hinton was there, and Bob Haggert. They had what they called the giants of jazz, the great giants of jazz.

items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was working with Gus Johnson ... with his sister when he got altizmers

ctx.x: I know it, and I researched it because when Gus Johnson just got sick here recently, I was working with Gus Johnson [unintelligible] with his sister when he got altizmers. He‟s still in bad condition. I went down to Local 10 and found out there is a trust fund that you can apply to.
